stories.headline: Fernandes Puts 123 Beyond All Reason
stories.deck: 123 hammer test31121 by 41 behind a Bruno Fernandes hat-trick and Haaland double
stories.body:
123 did not win a match this round, they conducted an audit. 76 to 35 over test31121, the widest margin the desk logged, and every number pointed one way.

B.Fernandes ran it: three goals, one assist, the R1, pick 1 doing exactly what a first overall is drafted to do. Haaland added two behind him and Groß chipped a goal and an assist. test31121 had no answer, and Georginio carrying a knock did not help the count.

Elsewhere the margins were tighter. test4 saw off testf 56 to 45, test1 edged test211 48 to 40, test3 nipped test31 38 to 28, and test2 held off test3331 49 to 40. Four honest results and one demolition.

123 sit at the top of the conversation after that. When your R1 pick returns thirteen points of goal involvement on his own and your R3 forward doubles up, the table looks after itself.

test4 keep pace with a win over testf, Cherki and Mbeumo both returning. test1, test3 and test2 all bank narrow ones. test31121 and test3331 are the men left counting what went wrong.

B.Fernandes walks in and takes the armband with him. Three and one for 123, the round's outstanding return, and nobody comes close. Haaland alongside him with the brace, Cherki matching the goal count for test4.

Across the middle Gibbs-White, Mbeumo and João Pedro all posted a goal and an assist apiece, the sort of dual returns that win weeks. Scott chipped in a goal and kept a clean sheet on test3331's ledger, a tidy shift for an R5, pick 48.

At the back Tarkowski scored for testf, while Dedić and Calafiori paired a clean sheet with an assist. Groß is the unlucky one to slide down the order, a goal and an assist for 123 and still not front of the queue on a day like this.

ties.line: test1 edged it 48 to 40, João Pedro's goal and assist not enough to save test211.
test3 home by 38 to 28, Gibbs-White returning a goal and an assist and Calafiori a clean sheet and an assist.
test4 by 56 to 45, Cherki and Mbeumo doing the damage against Tarkowski's goal for testf.
test2 held on 49 to 40, Scott and Dedić's clean-sheet returns not enough for test3331.
76 to 35. B.Fernandes three and one, Haaland two, Groß one and one. test31121 flattened.
